comment: oads dataset pack schema — tool/gen/ds/generate.py emits manifests, configs, dispatch, facades, Python wrappers, and license/doc tables from this file. Decode bodies and custom Dataset impls stay handwritten in src/rs/<domain>/<name>.rs.

audio.py_doc:
Audio datasets: clip archives decoded to PCM waveform matrices and MIDI
performances decoded to (pitch, step, duration) event matrices.

Waveform loaders upload a [N, 1, S] f32 sample matrix and a [N] f32 label
matrix; sequence loaders expose fixed-length event windows as device
slices. Both collate through `oa.data` without padding.

image.py_doc:
Image datasets: IDX-digit packs and archive-decoded photographic corpora.

Every loader uploads a [N, C, H, W] f32 image matrix and a [N] f32 label
matrix, so per-sample slices collate to NCHW batches through `oa.data`.

text.doc: Text datasets: character and document corpora.
text.py_doc: Text datasets: character and document corpora.

video.py_doc:
Video datasets: frame-sequence corpora.

Loaders upload a [N, T, C, H, W] f32 frame matrix; per-sample slices
collate to NTCHW batches through `oa.data`.

tabular.py_doc:
Tabular datasets: fixed-width numeric feature matrices with class labels.

Every loader uploads a [N, F] f32 feature matrix and a [N] f32 label
matrix, so per-sample slices collate to [B, F] batches through `oa.data`.
Packs arrive unsplit; partition with `oa.data.random_split`.
